conversations.title: Why dating, motherhood remain lonely battles for women with sickle cell
conversations.reply: It's heartbreaking that women with sickle cell face such tough times in dating and motherhood, and it's not them, it's the system that needs to change. I'm so glad you're speaking out about this.

conversations.title: Phill Jupitus says 'David Byrne effectively shat on a minority' for excluding disabled people and fans who can't stand at show
conversations.reply: Phill Jupitus is spot on, David Byrne's decision is a real shame. It's great that people are calling him out on it, and I hope it leads to some real change.

conversations.title: Accessibility is top priority for the Fleadh in Belfast this August
conversations.reply: The Fleadh in Belfast is setting a fantastic example by prioritizing accessibility, it's amazing to think about the difference it will make for attendees. This is what inclusion looks like.

conversations.title: What Love Island tells us about the changing face of dating
conversations.reply: Love Island might not be perfect, but it's interesting to see how it reflects the changing face of dating. Maybe it's time for more diverse contestants and storylines that show different relationships.

conversations.title: Chicago summer in full swing this weekend with Fiesta Del Sol, WNBA All-Star Game, festivals
conversations.reply: Chicago's summer events look like so much fun, and it's great to see the Disability Pride Parade included. It's a wonderful step towards creating a more accessible and welcoming atmosphere.

conversations.title: Friday briefing: How disabled creators are challenging an ableist world
conversations.reply: It's fantastic to see disabled creators pushing for change and challenging the status quo. Their work is making a real difference and promoting inclusion.

conversations.title: Witney Town Council marks Disability Pride Month with Town Hall display
conversations.reply: Witney Town Council's display for Disability Pride Month is a lovely gesture, and it's great to see local authorities showing their support. Let's hope it's just the start of a more inclusive approach.

conversations.title: Manchester named world's third most sexually liberal city
conversations.reply: Manchester's reputation is interesting, but let's think about how it intersects with disability and accessibility. Are the city's queer spaces and events truly inclusive, or are there still barriers to access?
